prompt: Create a premium vertical 3:4 retro-futurist editorial poster on a deep charcoal-black textured paper background, with a worn halftone print finish, cream ink typography, and electric cyan-blue/orange accent lighting. Center the composition on a male Greco-Roman marble bust, cropped at the chest, facing slightly to the viewer’s right with a calm classical expression and curly hair. Split the head and torso down the vertical center: the viewer’s right half remains a blue-lit marble human bust, while the viewer’s left half is exposed cybernetic machinery replacing the skull, ear, neck, and shoulder, with circular mechanical ear plates, cables, pistons, dark metal parts, and thin orange rim light. Behind the bust, place one enormous condensed block-capital headline reading HUMAN in tall cream letters, partially obscured by the head. At the very top, add a small centered Portuguese tagline reading A IA AMPLIA. O HUMANO DIRECIONA., flanked by short cream barcode-like dash marks. Add two warped cream wireframe grid panels behind the bust, one on each side, plus two small starburst spark icons. On the left side, set a vertical Portuguese quote in small cream type reading A inteligência artificial acelera caminhos. A sensibilidade humana escolhe a direção. Juntas, transformam possibilidades em progresso.. On the right side, stack the year 2026 as two large cream numbers, “20” above “26”. Along the bottom, create an editorial information band: a square cream-framed box with a black asterisk/sun icon, next to two outlined label boxes reading “TECNOLOGIA COM PROPÓSITO” and “Criatividade e inteligência”; to the right, add a large label reading HUMANOS NO CENTRO, a small spaced caption “COLABORAÇÃO...” and a thin progress bar ending with “70%”. Include exactly these discrete graphic/text elements: 1 main cyborg bust, 1 giant background headline, 1 top tagline line, 2 barcode dash groups, 2 warped wireframe grids, 2 starbursts, 1 vertical side quote, 1 stacked year marker, 1 asterisk icon box, 2 bottom label boxes, 1 bottom slogan, and 1 progress bar. Use strong editorial spacing, high contrast, gritty screenprint texture, subtle paper grain, vintage science-magazine layout, no photorealistic background scenery, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张 3:4 的高级垂直复古未来主义编辑风格海报，背景为深炭黑色纹理纸张，带有磨损的半色调印刷质感、奶油色墨水排版，以及电光青蓝色/橙色的强调照明。构图中心为一个希腊罗马式男性大理石半身像，胸部剪裁，面朝观众右侧，表情冷静古典，留着卷发。将头部和躯干沿垂直中心一分为二：观众右侧保持为蓝色光照下的大理石人像，而观众左侧则露出取代了头骨、耳朵、颈部和肩部的赛博机械结构，包括圆形机械耳板、电缆、活塞、深色金属部件以及细微的橙色轮廓光。在半身像后方，放置一个巨大的压缩块状大写标题 HUMAN，使用高大的奶油色字母，并被头部部分遮挡。在最上方，添加一行居中的小型葡萄牙语标语 A IA AMPLIA. O HUMANO DIRECIONA.，两侧配以短小的奶油色条形码状短横线。在半身像后方添加两个扭曲的奶油色线框网格面板，每侧一个，外加两个小型星爆火花图标。在左侧，设置一段垂直的葡萄牙语引文，使用小型奶油色字体 A inteligência artificial acelera caminhos. A sensibilidade humana escolhe a direção. Juntas, transformam possibilidades em progresso.。在右侧，将年份 2026 堆叠为两个巨大的奶油色数字，“20”在上，“26”在下。在底部，创建一个编辑信息栏：一个带有黑色星号/太阳图标的方形奶油色边框框，旁边是两个带轮廓的标签框，分别写着“TECNOLOGIA COM PROPÓSITO”和“Criatividade e inteligência”；在右侧，添加一个大标签 HUMANOS NO CENTRO，一个带有间距的小型说明文字“COLABORAÇÃO...”，以及一个以“70%”结尾的细进度条。包含以下精确的离散图形/文本元素：1 个主体赛博半身像、1 个巨型背景标题、1 行顶部标语、2 组条形码短横线、2 个扭曲的线框网格、2 个星爆图标、1 段垂直侧边引文、1 个堆叠年份标记、1 个星号图标框、2 个底部标签框、1 个底部口号和 1 个进度条。使用强烈的编辑间距、高对比度、粗犷的丝网印刷质感、细腻的纸张纹理、复古科学杂志布局，无写实背景景观，无水印。
